New fields default to the safe no-op value for existing non-risky inputs.
Bridge/proxy authority, retrieval-derived evidence without exact source fetch, ECC external intake, and unproven OPENCODE/GROK backend provenance override caller-claimed authority.
requires_mcp_call continues to route to RED_LANE.
Classifier logic remains deterministic and pure with no I/O, network, shell, runner, connector, MCP, or dopetask calls.

pr.body: Implements DMX-DCP-MODEL-ROUTING-MVP-0006. Provenance signals can only lower trust, bridge/proxy and retrieval-derived advisory evidence fail closed for mutation, ECC external intake is static/read-only only, and unproven OPENCODE/GROK backend mutation is blocked. The read-only CLI adapter carries the new provenance fields for inspection, but 0007 remains a blocking co-requisite before any execution surface may consume runnable classifier output. No execution, connector, runner, MCP, or live-write surface is added.
pr.title: feat(dcp): harden routing classifier provenance

requirements: Identify where RoutingClassificationInput is constructed and where classify_route output is consumed.
Inspect src/dopemux/commands/dcp_commands.py::_input_from_dict and verify whether read-only CLI input carries all provenance fields.
Confirm no executor currently reads LaneDecision.is_executable and that this packet may merge before the execution-inert 0005 lane-engine MVP.
steps.task: Inspect routing classifier runtime flow, routing model types, existing tests, CLI consumers, and DCP lane-engine consumers before changing code.
validation: Inspection notes identify canonical runtime flow and downstream consumers before implementation.

requirements: Add authority_via_bridge_proxy, evidence_is_retrieval_derived, exact_source_fetched, is_ecc_external_intake, and has_backend_wrapper_proof fields only if runtime inspection confirms they belong on RoutingClassificationInput.
Wire the five provenance fields through the read-only CLI input adapter so classify output reflects caller-supplied provenance evidence.
Derive backend-wrapper risk from backend_kind for OPENCODE and GROK rather than trusting a separate caller boolean alone.
Keep has_backend_wrapper_proof default false without regressing existing non-OPENCODE and non-GROK inputs.
Include all new provenance fields in route-id stability inputs so provenance changes produce distinct route IDs.
Do not change lane-engine behavior, connector behavior, runner behavior, MCP calls, live-write surfaces, or execution eligibility.
steps.task: Add provenance fields and classifier coercion rules so risky provenance overrides caller-claimed authority and blocks mutation deterministically.
validation: Bridge/proxy authority with claimed AUTOMATED_SAFE no longer returns runnable ALLOWED.
Retrieval-derived evidence without exact source fetch blocks mutation but exact_source_fetched preserves the non-derived behavior.
CLI JSON carrying provenance fields reaches classify_route and produces the same fail-closed decision as in-memory input.
Route IDs remain deterministic for identical inputs and differ when trust-lowering provenance fields differ.
ECC external intake blocks runner execution, live writes, destructive paths, copy, and import.
OPENCODE and GROK backend mutation requires wrapper proof while other backend kinds preserve existing defaults.

steps.task: Run focused DCP validation, diff hygiene, and independent embedded audit before merge.
validation: All listed commands pass or failures are reported with exact blocker evidence.
Embedded audit confirms provenance signals can only lower trust, coercion overrides claimed authority, requires_mcp_call remains RED_LANE, and no regression is introduced.
Diff remains inside the packet allowlist.

target: Harden the DCP routing classifier and read-only CLI input adapter against provenance laundering by adding explicit provenance signals that can only lower trust, while declaring the 0007 trusted input-provenance contract as a blocking co-requisite before any execution surface may consume runnable classifier output.
